daily_report_items: Planet Labs full Q2 review: strong growth, retention and liquidity did not overcome capital intensity, dilution and valuation. The refreshed USD 13.045 weighted value is below the USD 16.69 mark; deterministic gates retain Sell / Avoid, allocation-ineligible and no new paper position. One bounded defense-and-aerospace relationship review was queued.

evidence.claim: For the quarter ended 2026-07-31, revenue was USD 116.052 million, gross profit USD 65.632 million and GAAP operating loss USD 13.509 million, compared with USD 73.386 million, USD 42.268 million and USD 17.960 million in the comparable prior-year quarter. Cash and short-term investments were USD 865.4 million, while reported common shares, unvested RSUs, options and other warrants establish material dilution inputs.
evidence.source: Planet Labs PBC Q2 fiscal 2027 Form 10-Q

evidence.claim: The issuer reported 62% year-over-year Q2 revenue growth, 97% recurring ACV, 110% net retention, positive adjusted EBITDA and operating cash flow, and maintained fiscal 2027 revenue guidance of USD 430-441 million. RPO and backlog were below April levels, FY2027 capex guidance increased to USD 100-115 million, and hardware contribution and ATM issuance make per-share valuation and cash conversion central risks.
evidence.source: Planet Labs PBC Q2 fiscal 2027 financial results filed with the SEC

evidence.claim: The SEC submissions index was checked through 2026-09-11; the 2026-09-03 Q2 Form 10-Q and results filing remain the latest material operating evidence, with subsequent Form 4 and Section 16 notices not changing the operating conclusion.
evidence.source: SEC submissions index for Planet Labs PBC

summary: Completed one bounded full Planet Labs security review using current SEC-filed Q2 fiscal 2027 evidence and fresh canonical price/FX identity. Revenue, retention, operating leverage and liquidity improved, but capital intensity, contract concentration, ATM issuance and broader dilution remain material. Published schema-v2 assessment assessment_9ea04b63e769b8d9b31d with USD 6.30/USD 12.71/USD 24.00 bear/base/bull values and USD 13.045 probability-weighted value against the USD 16.69 mark. Deterministic gates classify the security Sell / Avoid, allocation-ineligible and no_new_position because expected and base returns are negative, payoff and margin-of-safety gates fail, and the canonical relationship remains pending. Retained the existing commercial-space relationship review and created exactly one defense-and-aerospace relationship review. No strategy, signal, paper order, allocation, fill, cash, portfolio, performance or accounting state changed.
